fills.notes: After “He too is one among the gods” the substrate formula typically continues with the coordination: he is among them, and many gods are with him (his company/host).
The sequence is a numbered interrogation. After “The third thing…” the expected connective is a request “to recount/explain to me how…” before stating the purity of Mind vs. bodily defilement.
The contrast demanded is: Mind is holy/pure, yet the body is defilement; thus the question is how he can bear/endure it without being stained.
Fits: “All that you have unveiled you have declared in our presence.” The substrate voice prefers impersonal ‘declare/unveil’ rather than exhortation.
Restores the idiom: “I wanted to know about the Light Mind…”
Stomach as the “five unfolded ones” must be identified as a section/edge of the cosmic ‘garment’; ‘hem/edge’ is the natural correspondence to a lower enclosing boundary.
What runs from navel to hip corresponds to channels/bands issuing from the stellar sphere toward the four quarters—i.e., the cosmic ‘routes/conduits’ distributing influences to the corners.
Loins = three earths below, positioned upon the Porter’s head; needs a linking verbal phrase of emplacement.
Between loins and shins/feet the body-part mapping expects an intermediate terrestrial structure; “mountain-ridges” naturally correspond to thighs as supports between trunk and lower legs.

fills.fill: knees are the joints of the earths
fills.notes: Knees correspond to joints/hinges; in a cosmography they mark junctions/turnings between levels/regions beneath the Porter.
Lower legs/feet commonly map to sea/abyssal zones and the ‘zone’ beneath; the text then continues “and the entire zone that belongs …”.
Completes the cadence: shins/feet = seas/abyss + the whole lower zone belonging to them.
The bracket already indicates restoration; simplest is to keep “which” to complete “the wall that … surrounds …”.
After “outer skin is the wall…” the next anatomical correspondence should be the layer just within: an ‘inner skin’ mapping to the fiery enclosure’s immediate containment/lining.
Likely plural predicate with “vessels”: “His … are the vessels of the great fire.”
Too little constraint for the specific organ; only the transition “His … His” is assured.
In the sequence of inner organs, a storage vessel naturally corresponds to ‘storehouse’ in the cosmos; placed near ‘vessels of the great fire’ / ‘of darkness’.
Tongue corresponds to utterance; cosmically, to the ‘speech/voice’ issuing in the constructed world (cf. later “living word/utterance/obedience”).
Eyes/ears are often paired as perception organs; if eyes are uncertain, ears as ‘winds’ (hearing via air) fits the correspondential chain of elements.
Ends: “His feet are his …” The natural completion is “toes,” closing the anatomical catalog.
Connects: “Five gods are fastened in him. And they are his soul and his life …”
Introduces causal clarification: the ‘cosmic man’ is called sinner because of mixture; needs “for/because”.
Reinforces the explanatory tone: “because … the Living Spirit and the Ambassador …”.
Grammatically needed: “the Living Spirit and the Ambassador are … the five sleepless guardians.”
Paragraph 14 enumerates cosmic offices installed in the Great Body; the recurring verb is “he has set/appointed/placed”.
Keeper of Splendour is aligned with ‘mind’ above; in this schema the highest interior quality corresponding to mind is love (later: Mind = love in ¶40).

fills.fill: also set in him the full measure
fills.notes: Matches the idiom “he has … whole … of the powers of heaven” — i.e., totality/measure gathered into an office.
Powers of heaven are ‘in the camp’/station of the King of Honour; ‘camp’ matches the surrounding military/watch-district vocabulary.

fills.fill: who is the thought that exists i
He has also appointed the Adamant of Light
fills.notes: The next named hypostasis is Adamant of Light; the enumerative structure demands an appointment formula.
Adamant is explicitly glossed as ‘insight’ later in ¶35-40 mapping; keep substrate functional gloss.
The Adamant’s operation is over the lower triplicity; ties into later disturbances in the three earths.
Resumes the appointment chain; avoid Christian/pastoral phrasing.
Restores “counsel” construction around King of Glory as counsel/patience.
King of Glory governs three ‘images/wheels’ (wind/fire/water). The handing-over is for restraining evilness so it does not erupt in those elemental wheels.
Continuation of the restraint clause: prevent uprising/evilness.
Matches later: foundations loosened; Porter’s watch involves foundation below. Restraining disturbance of foundations is thematically consistent.
Introduces Porter in the enumerative list.
Porter is “consideration … wisdom … below”; needs “in him” (in the great body/cosmos).
Completes: “foundation below …” The Porter’s station is beneath the three earths as the supporting base.
“He has made strong these camps … by their measures” fits correspondential ‘measure’ as the limiting form that keeps each watch-district secure.
“It went … in the third firmament” needs a simple verb of motion/continuation; “was” is least constrained but grammatical: “It went and was in…”
Restores “watch-tower of the Keeper of Splendour.”
“He is made … with wrath” requires a participle like ‘troubled/stirred up’; correspondentially wrath = violent heat in the middle firmament.
After “destruction, on the earth” the typical continuation in this mythic strand is an added deluge as corrective/containment. Fits “[…] to it.”
Restores “The Adamant of Light … the fulfillment.”
Adamant is set firm upon a particular lower level; “third earth” matches the tri-earth scheme and later earthquakes in “these three earths.”
Minimum to make: “for they were pained and oppressed…”
Paths/tracks are impeded; later Jesus “straightened the tracks”.
Bridges the clauses: paths closed; ascent impeded; then explanation about elements ascending.

fills.fill: the uprising of the depths was
fills.notes: Porter governs below; the disturbance is the uprising of the depths/abysses; needs verbal framing.
Pairs with “bent” and “fastenings … loosened”.
Summarises the consequence: loosening of fastenings in the foundation below implies earthquake.
Pillar of Glory came forth “as it was made the helper…”
The agent sent here is Jesus in his rescuing function; elsewhere the text names “Jesus the Youth” as an installed power (¶17).
Links: “he sent Jesus … the invocation of the five sons.” i.e., with the invocation/summoning formula.
“He assumed them from the abortions.”
Fastenings “that had been set” beneath the Porter; then loosened. Needs relative clause.
“He returned, he came up to his place of rest.” Standard ascent-to-rest formula.
“watching over them continually” matches the watch-duty theme.
Parallels earthquakes/uprisings in cosmic body; “tremblings” is the natural counterpart to internal agitation.
Needs a temporal-causal turn: after permitting error briefly, then they seize; this is “afterward” and “because” of prior righteous judgement.
“These gods, in that they too are great…” parallels the argument about Mind in body.
“bearing up till …” expects “till the completion/end” (telos) of their appointed station.
The five placed on the soul are the Dark Substance’s governance-powers; “rulers” matches ‘authorities’ and the enslaving function.
Hostility arises toward the source; the soul, in forgetfulness, turns against its origin.
Balances: hostile to its father and against itself.
Correspondential result of hostility: obscuring/darkening its own light.
“finds the soul in the bonds” is demanded by the immediate description of loosening bonds in the body.
“assuming it in the body” fits the incarnational/indwelling logic without Christian overlay.
“its wisdom …” requires an instrumental connector.
Mind becomes “a guide” to the soul in the body, fitting impersonal functional titles.
He loosens/release/binds; thus “unbinder of the bonds.”

fills.fill: mind of the soul and relea

fills.notes: After purifying the ‘image of the word’ and adding his word, the result is that the word becomes ‘speech’—active utterance that nourishes/strengthens the new man.
The nourisher/strengthener relation is directed to the constructed ‘new man’.
The line is about completing the “twelve members”; the verbs earlier are “form/purify/construct”; here “perfect/arrange” is expected.

fills.fill: it is accomplished in his love
fills.notes: The twelvefold perfection is ‘how’ love/wisdom act in ultimates; fits the later “and his wisdom.”
The subject whose state changes righteous is the mind of the person/new man.
“as he perfects him” is the grammatical need.
Formerly he ran after lust; now he runs after the road/path upward.
Opposite correspondence: lust vs righteousness.
Triplet “road … path … track” fits Coptic style of near-synonyms.
Completes the ascent parallelism.
Ascent culminates in rest in the great aeons.
Old man is bound “in the body”.
The clause continues listing lust/folly in the five members of the body; needs connective.
“Yet, his king is the Light Mind” is required.
“While the members are bound, thus the Dark Substance is imprisoned.”
After “foolish words” the natural pair is “empty/idle (words)”. Keeps impersonal moral-psychological register without Christian overlay.
Disturbance “in the body of the Light Mind” is the point of the analogy; earlier: Mind’s watch-district is “the body of the flesh.”
They are set firm in the zone but not visible; “invisibly” names the mode of presence.
“have contorted themselves” is immediately followed by “they have … they have become small”; the missing verb is the more exact ‘contracted’.

fills.fill: s camp in the body, he is not defiled
fills.notes: Completes the analogy: though set fast in mingling, the gods are not defiled; so the Light Mind, though placed in his camp within the body, is undefiled.

assessment: Most single-letter and mid-word lacunae are mechanically secure. Several larger gaps (esp. ¶11–12 anatomical cosmography and ¶14 appointment catalog) allow only structurally constrained restorations; I restored them by maintaining the correspondential mapping (cosmic ‘body/garment’, watch-district stations, restraint of elemental wheels) and the impersonal substrate register. A few places remain minimal/too underdetermined (notably ¶12 #6), where the manuscript offers insufficient constraints for a responsible specific noun.
